rpculinary.msg.faint: Your vision darkens... your legs give way.
rpculinary.msg.full: Stomach is full. Only by force from now on…
rpculinary.msg.hunger_1: Your stomach growls. Time to eat.
rpculinary.msg.hunger_3: Your body is eating itself. You need food now.
rpculinary.monotony.meat: Meat again... you can barely swallow it.
rpculinary.monotony.grain: Porridge and bread again. You're sick of it.
rpculinary.monotony.vegetables: Only vegetables... you want something else.
rpculinary.monotony.sweet: Too sweet. The sweets are making you queasy.
rpculinary.screen.title: Nutrition
rpculinary.screen.unknown: The server sent no nutrition data.
rpculinary.screen.hunger_2: Very hungry: no strength, weak hands.
rpculinary.screen.hunger_3: Starving: your body burns its reserves and you lose weight. You may faint.
rpculinary.screen.low_protein: Weak muscles; scrapes and wounds heal slowly.
rpculinary.screen.low_fat: You feel chilly all the time; dry skin.
rpculinary.screen.low_carbs: No energy; you get winded fast.
rpculinary.screen.low_vitamins: Pale, brittle nails, you catch colds easily.
rpculinary.screen.balanced: You feel lively: you eat well.
rpculinary.screen.lab_hint: Exact values — only by a lab blood test.
rpculinary.cmd.reset: Nutrition reset for %s players (weight and fat kept).
rpculinary.cmd.status_food: Satiety %s (reserve %s kcal, stomach %s), hunger stage %s; burns ~%s kcal per hour of play
rpculinary.cmd.status_nutrients: P %s · F %s · C %s · vit. %s; fed-up mask %s; poor appetite %s
rpculinary.cmd.status_body: Weight %s kg, fat %s %%, lean mass %s kg; recently eaten %s kcal
rpculinary.cmd.status_iv: IV feeding: %s kcal left over %s min
rpculinary.cmd.audit: Food composition: datapack %s, from recipes %s, estimated only %s. Full list — rpculinary-audit.txt in the server folder.
rpculinary.cmd.audit_estimated: Estimated from vanilla nutrition (add to datapack rpculinary/nutrition): %s
rpculinary.tooltip.advice_too_fatty: Dietitian: you've had plenty of fat already.
rpculinary.tooltip.advice_thirst: Dietitian: it will also quench thirst.
rpculinary.screen.dietitian_numbers: Satiety %s%%, water %s%% · P %s · F %s · C %s · vit. %s · recent %s kcal
rpculinary.help.audit: where food composition comes from (debug; file rpculinary-audit.txt)
rpculinary.sense.stomach_injury: Sharp pain in your belly — something's wrong.
rpculinary.sense.pressure: Ringing in your head, pressure in the temples.
rpculinary.sense.scurvy_severe: Gums bleeding, aching all over, loose teeth.
rpculinary.monotony.method: Always the same thing. I want something different.
